headline: Nevish Line Erupts as Weathered Expanse Battle Grinds On
war_summary: The tactical focus has shifted over the past three hours as Nevish Line erupted into intense combat, logging eight base transactions and mounting casualties around Blackcoat Way and Tomb Father. Weathered Expanse remains the war's most violent cauldron, recording ten base turnovers in the last two hours alone alongside surging casualty rates near Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest, and Frostmarch, which leave two strongpoints unoccupied. Fighting has also stirred back to life in Marban Hollow, producing three quick exchanges over Oster Wall and Checkpoint Bua. In contrast, the rapid turnover previously seen in The Gutter and Palantine Berm has cooled considerably, with The Gutter registering only two events and Palantine Berm falling silent during the latest two-hour interval. Meanwhile, brutal frontal collisions in Callahan's Passage continue to extract an immense human toll, generating over two thousand combined casualties without dislodging the established line.
